tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Searches places, streets, and house numbers in the place index of NeuronForm and returns candidates with name, lat, lon, and kind.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Compiles a short brief into a complete design with the configurator defaults; the centre given by place or lat and lon is the centre of tile 0. Invalid values fall back to their defaults with a notice naming the brief field. Change the result with edit_design.

tools.name: edit_design
tools.description: Changes a design and returns the complete changed design, validated against the rules and the limits of anonymous use. changes takes brief fields (an absent field keeps the design: width, rotation, model_width, exaggeration, relief, frame, colors, label, tiles, shape, or place or lat and lon to move

tools.name: get_design_guide
tools.description: Returns the guide of one topic of the design JSON with the JSON schema of its fields.

tools.name: find_map_elements
tools.description: Lists roads and paths, buildings, areas, or ground regions of the design with a ready-to-insert request fragment and its target path; a building also carries the placement of a custom house that replaces it.

tools.name: edit_tiles
tools.description: Adds a tile at, or removes the tile at, a compass side of a tile and returns the updated design.

tools.name: validate_design
tools.description: Checks a design against the request rules, the limits of anonymous use, and the restricted areas without generating it.

tools.name: render_design
tools.description: Renders a design as an image, returns its summary, and opens the interactive 3D viewer where the host supports it. The default overview shows four 3D views from the north, east, south, and west beside the top view with north up and a scale bar, so proportions and relief read from every side; view to

tools.name: share_design
tools.description: Stores the design and returns a link, valid for 90 days, that opens exactly this design in the NeuronForm configurator.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: Lists published gallery templates with slug, title, and image URL; with a slug it returns the design of that template.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_templates · Public sink: edit_design, share_design.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_templates · Public sink: edit_design, share_design

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
